title: The Seventh Door
text: Six doors in the Shrine, each to a god, each carved with that god's sign. A seventh, unmarked and older than the rest, stands ajar. Cold air comes through the gap, and a smell like turned earth.

options.label: Go through the seventh door, to meet whatever no one prays to.

outcomes.text: A god no one prays to, glad of visitors, and its gifts are strange.
Something that is not a god.

options.label: The wisest chooses one of the six, and trusts the gods they know.

outcomes.text: The right one, and warm light behind it.

options.label: Shut the seventh door, before whatever lies behind it comes through.

outcomes.text: It does not want to shut. It takes all of you, and arms that ache for days.
